title: Validate canonical lookup and aggregation behavior
description: Add and run focused CookbookCore tests covering the new canonical lookup helper and the full aggregation behavior matrix, including ordering and determinism.
acceptance_criteria: `AisleConfigParserTests` covers canonical-token lookup, alias lookup, trimming/casing behavior, and unmatched lookup for `canonical(for:)`.

A new `AggregationTests.swift` covers the acceptance matrix for empty input, nil-vs-configured aisle behavior, same-unit summing, mixed-unit preservation, alias canonicalisation, text quantities, quantity-less ingredients, unmatched ingredients, aisle ordering, item ordering, and determinism.
Tests are pure `swift test` coverage with no simulator dependency.
The shared tester bead depends on every developer bead in the feature tree.
